title: Team-scoped models must be on IDOR semgrep lists and a fail-closed EnvironmentScopedManager
answers: How to make a model environment scoped without leaking sibling environments' rows
Why does the model have all_teams and objects managers?
body: A new per-environment model must (1) use `objects = EnvironmentScopedManager()` (filters by literal team id, so sibling environments cannot read it) with `all_teams = models.Manager()` and `Meta.default_manager_name = "all_teams"` (products/tracing/backend/models.py:TracesRetentionRule), and (2) be added to BOTH class-name alternation lists in .semgrep/rules/security/idor-team-scoped-models.yaml. `.github/scripts/check-idor-model-coverage.py` checks this; skipping either fails CI or leaves an IDOR blind spot.
applies: New models with a team FK in PostHog products.
